reason: A client-side conversation navigation panel that displays one icon per turn, supports smooth定位 to user messages, highlights the visible turn, and updates with the session.

summaries.zh: 在对话区左缘显示按轮次排列的图标列，帮助用户点击定位、查看当前轮次并浏览会话内容。
summaries.en: Adds a left-edge turn rail that helps users navigate conversation turns, locate user messages, and track the currently viewed turn.

capabilities: Reads conversation session snapshots and turn metadata
Renders a client-side turn navigation rail and hover tooltips
Scrolls to conversation turn anchors and tracks the visible turn
Updates the interface from local conversation state
Does not use network access, filesystem access, process spawning, or host RPC
